purpose: Rail-constraint and photo-derived pTLC laboratory scene assembly for simulation blocking

coordinate_frame.name: rail_constraint_layout_v2
coordinate_frame.x_axis: +X follows the fitted rail L direction
coordinate_frame.y_axis: +Y follows the fitted transverse N direction
coordinate_frame.origin: arbitrary rigid-frame origin used by the rail-relative point analysis; it is not a surveyed laboratory datum
coordinate_frame.accuracy: rail-relative constraint layout plus photo interpretation; not surveyed world geometry

controller_frame_boundary.controller_frame: DOBOT User 0 / Tool 1 records as supplied by the controller API
controller_frame_boundary.rule: Only the fitted relative L/N/Z constraint frame is used for marker overlays. Markers are TCP targets, never device centers or surveyed world points.

rail_station_markers.anchor_rule: Slot 1/2 is drawn at X=0.000 m; only inter-slot offsets come from the fitted rail scale. This anchor makes CR5 reach to the fitted target clusters plausible but is not a calibration.
